title: Pia, Mas Malaking Pabor
setup: Lumapit si Pia, kinakabahan. 'Kailangan kong sabihin kay Ma'am Lourdes na ikaw ang kumuha ng ambagan. Hindi ko kaya… pero ikaw, pwede.'
setup_en: Pia approaches you, nervous. 'I need to tell Ma'am Lourdes that you took the donation money. I can't do it… but you can.'

success.text: Nagalit si Pia, pero iginagalang ka niya.
success.text_en: Pia is upset, but she respects you.

fail.text: Kumalat ang tsismis. Nasaktan ang samahan.
fail.text_en: Rumors spread. The group is hurt.

choices.label: Sige, ako na ang magsabi.
choices.label_en: Fine, I'll be the one to tell.

choices.label: Sabihin natin ang totoo, tayong dalawa.
choices.label_en: Let's tell the truth, both of us.

success.text: Naging maayos ang lahat. Mas malasakit kayo.
success.text_en: It works out. You grow closer.

fail.text: Nadismaya si Ma'am sa inyong dalawa, pero tama ang ginawa ninyo.
fail.text_en: Ma'am is disappointed in both of you, but you did right.
